description:
Berit Klinik sucht für den Standort Speicher eine engagierte Persönlichkeit.

Position: Mitarbeiter:In Restaurant 60–80%.

Berit Klinik AG | Vögelinsegg 5 | 9042 Speicher | +41 71 335 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch Über die Berit Klinik Die Berit Klinik Gruppe betreibt sieben Standorte in der Ostschweiz und ist in Speicher und Niederteufen führend in Or- thopädie, Wirbelsäulenchirurgie und Re- habilitation. In Wattwil stehen eine 24/7- Notfallstation, eine Tagesklinik, diverse Sprechstunden, Radiologie, ein Labor und die PSA, eine Kurzzeittherapie für Alko- holkranke, zur Verfügung. In Goldach bietet die Klinik Hand- und periphere Nervenchirurgie, Sprechstunden in Augen- heilkunde und Orthopädie sowie ein Ma- gen-Darm-Zentrum an. Die Berit Sportcli- nic ist in Speicher, Arbon und Heerbrugg vertreten. Seit 2025 ergänzt das Berit Sportslab in St. Gallen das Angebot im Bereich Athletiktraining. Berit Klinik è alla ricerca di una personalità dedicata per la posizione di stoccaggio. Posizione: Dipendente: Nel ristorante 60–80%. Berit Klinik AG | Vögelinsegg 5 | 9042 Memoria | +41 71 335 06 06 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch Il Gruppo Clinica Berit gestisce sette sedi nella Svizzera orientale ed è leader nella memoria e nell'ortopedia, nella chirurgia spinale e nella riabilitazione. A Wattwil c'è una stazione di emergenza 24/7, una clinica quotidiana, diverse ore di conversazione, radiologia, un laboratorio e la PSA, una terapia a breve termine per alco-holkranke. In Goldach, la clinica offre la chirurgia del nervo per la mano e la periferica, parlando ore in medicina oculare e ortopedia, così come un centro Ma-gen-Darm. Il Berit Sportcli- nic è rappresentato in Memoria, Arbon e Heerbrugg. Dal 2025, Berit Sportslab a St. Gallen ha aggiunto l'offerta nel campo della formazione atletica. Ms. Sandra Egger Head of Gastronomy T +41 71 335 06 28 sandra.egger@klinik.ch Applicazione a Ms. Vanessa Grimaldi Head of Human Resources Service hr@klinik.ch Staff/in Restaurant, 60–80% per la nostra posizione in Memory AR | secondo accordo I vostri compiti

• Vi offriamo
• Ambiente di lavoro moderno in una bella posizione
• Lavoro reattivo e vario in un team motivato
• Alto livello di auto-occupazione

descriptionByLocale.en:
Berit Klinik is looking for a committed personality for the Speicher location. Position: Employee: In restaurant 60-80%. Berit Klinik AG | Vogelinsegg 5 | 9042 memory | +41 71 335 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch About the Berit Clinic The Berit Clinic Group operates seven locations in eastern Switzerland and is a leader in orthopedics, spinal surgery and rehabilitation in Speicher and Niederteufen. In Wattwil there is a 24/7 emergency ward, a day clinic, various consultation hours, radiology, a laboratory and PPE, a short-term therapy for alcoholics. In Goldach, the clinic offers hand and peripheral nerve surgery, consultations in ophthalmology and orthopedics as well as a gastrointestinal center. The Berit Sportclinic is represented in Speicher, Arbon and Heerbrugg. The Berit Sportslab in St. Gallen has been supplementing the athletic training offering since 2025. If you have any questions, contact Ms. Sandra Egger, Head of Gastronomy T +41 71 335 06 28 sandra.egger@klinik.ch Application to Ms. Vanessa Grimaldi, Head of Human Resources hr@klinik.ch Restaurant employee, 60-80% for our location in Speicher AR | by appointment Your tasks
• Serving and looking after our patients and guests in our restaurants
• Providing the necessary mise en place according to specifications
• Preparing and collecting guest bills
• General minor cleaning work Your profile
• You have experience in the restaurant business, training is an advantage
• You speak German fluently
• Regular assignments on weekends/holidays are possible for you (no night work)
• You are a team player, resilient and loyal personality
• You can be deployed flexibly We offer You
• Modern working environment in a beautiful location
• Responsible and varied work in a motivated team
• High degree of independence
• 5 weeks of vacation
• Attractive employee benefits
